description:
Who We Are:

We are a passionate and driven group of tech enthusiasts, space nerds, and problem-solvers participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge – Calicut Local Event. 

Why Join Our Team?

Joining us means joining a collaborative, ego-free, and high-energy environment where every idea is heard. We aren't just here to code under pressure; we're here to learn, experiment, build something we are genuinely proud of, and have fun doing it.
summary: Project Beypore Orbit addresses the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge by creating an engaging storytelling experience designed to introduce school-age space enthusiasts to NASA’s historical hardware left across the Moon and Mars. Since the 1960s, humanity has left behind incredible engineering marvels—from Apollo descent stages and lunar rovers to robotic explorers on the Martian surface. Our project brings these silent artifacts to life through immersive narratives, transforming complex space missions into captivating stories. This project is vital because it connects young minds to the rich heritage of space exploration, making science and history accessible while inspiring the next generation of engineers and space explorers.
details: Project Beypore Orbit is an immersive digital storytelling platform designed to re-engage school-age space enthusiasts with NASA’s historical hardware left across the Moon and Mars. Rather than presenting dry historical data, our project works by transforming technical mission logs, landing coordinates, and telemetry into captivating, character-driven narratives told from the perspective of the spacecraft themselves
